advisory.finding: test_usage_log_does_not_prefix_match_or_colon_split_provider_names asserts on the implementation TEXT/AST of usage_log.py (source under test) — no `.split(':')`/`.partition(':')`/`.startswith(':')` call node and no `anthropic`/`openai`/`bedrock` string literals — rather than observable behavior, making it a source-grepping change-detector that breaks on behavior-preserving refactors.
